purpose: Convert the already-closed retention engineering contract into concrete launch policy choices without inferring Product, Privacy, or Legal approval.

decisions.productMeaning: Account/public access is removed immediately; owned user-authored payload is physically purged on the scheduled content-retention stage after 30 days unless an active permitted hold blocks purge.

Restricted operational detail needed for abuse, moderation, security, support, cleanup, or dispute history may remain until the operational scrub stage, then personal/correlation/free-text detail is removed while minimized structural records remain.
Deletion immediately removes account/public access. Wand does not promise a reversible grace period or 30-day self-service recovery.

Only moderation, security, or legal holds are permitted. Hold create/release requires recent-auth admin authority, a recorded reason, and audit history. Expiry should be set when a determinate end exists; otherwise explicit admin release is required.

After payload purge and operational scrub, retain only stable IDs, revision numbering/relationships, deletion-event identity, and non-sensitive structure needed to preserve integrity of historical publication/moderation/report relationships. Do not retain deleted user-authored payload or unnecessary re-identifying detail.

Database and Storage recovery copies are separate assets. Prefer the shortest production recovery window that meets launch RPO/RTO; do not create longer-lived Wand copies by default. Restore into a non-production target first and reapply deletion/retention reconciliation before reopening writes.
decisions.providerPlanBinding: Record the actual Supabase production plan/backup window when the production environment is selected; any materially longer copy-retention policy requires D6 review.

decisions.productMeaning: Wand's database timers do not control processor copies/logs. Record the actual launch provider plan/configuration, minimize data sent to processors, and disclose provider-controlled retention where material.

Launch privacy/account-deletion copy must distinguish immediate loss of access/public visibility, 30-day payload purge, 365-day operational scrub, permitted holds, minimized structural records, backup copies, and provider-controlled copies/logs.

resend.note: Provider facts describe Resend's stated service retention and are not a Wand legal sufficiency conclusion.

nextAction: Obtain explicit Product/Privacy/Legal approvals or requested changes. Do not infer approval from this proposal.
